t1.generated_sql:
-- 2026 년 6 월 CPU 사용률 평균이 높은 상위 3 대 서버 조회
-- 기간: 2026-06-01 ~ 2026-06-30 (월간 통계)
-- 지표: CPU 사용률 (definition_name = 'Utilization', resource_type = 'server.Cpus')
-- 집계: 서버별 평균 사용률 (AVG)
-- 정렬: 평균 사용률 내림차순
-- 제한: 상위 3 대

SELECT
    svr.name AS server_name,
    svr.hostname AS os_hostname,
    svr.ipaddress AS ipaddress,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.resource_type = 'server.Cpus' AND s.definition_name = 'Utilization' AND s.avg_val BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 THEN s.avg_val END)::numeric, 2) AS cpu_avg_utilization
FROM polestar.cmm_resource r
JOIN polestar.cmm_resource svr
    ON svr.id = r.platform_resource_id
   AND svr.resource_type = 'server.Server'
JOIN polestar.cmm_metric_stat_m s
    ON r.id = s.resource_id
   AND s.definition_name = 'Utilization'
   AND s.stat_date = '202606'
WHERE r.resource_type = 'server.Cpus'
  AND r.dtime IS NULL
  AND svr.dtime IS NULL
GROUP BY svr.name, svr.hostname, svr.ipaddress
ORDER BY cpu_avg_utilization DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 3;

| SV-WEB-001 | svweb001 | 10.61.0.1 | 42.8 |
